manifest.name: dsh-pin-recall
manifest.description: Pin tool results or assistant replies, then recall them into the next model turn via /pin /pins /recall /unpin and Web card actions.

bundle.text:
# Host half: slash commands that pin and recall session evidence.
- insert:
    - id: dsh-pin-recall
      name: dsh-pin-recall

readme.text:
Pin assistant replies (or tool/text evidence) in a DeepSeek Harness session, then recall them into the model turn — with a Web card button.

[中文文档](./README.zh-CN.md)

dsh plugin --profile web add github:YOUR_USER/dsh-pin-recall
```

Restart `dsh --profile web` (or `pnpm dsh web` from a harness checkout). Open the Web UI and hard-refresh.

Requires Node.js and a profile that already stacks `@deepseek-ai/dsh-base` + `@deepseek-ai/dsh-web-app`.

On a **finished** assistant message, the bottom action row shows:

| Control | Action |
|---|---|
| Outline star | Toggle pin / unpin for that reply (fills when pinned; state hydrates from the session) |
| Corner-down-left icon | Inject all pins and wake the agent (`title`: 召回…) |

| Command | Effect |
|---|---|
| `/pin` · `/pin last` | Pin newest tool result or assistant message |
| `/pin tool` · `/pin assistant` | Pin newest of that kind |
| `/pin msg <messageId>` | Toggle pin for one assistant message (Web card) |
| `/pin status <messageId>` | Report whether that assistant message is pinned |
| `/pin text …` | Pin free-form text |
| `/pins` | List active pins |
| `/recall` | Queue all pins **and wake** the agent |
| `/recall p1` | Queue one pin and wake |
| `/recall quiet` | Queue without waking (send a message yourself) |
| `/unpin p1` · `/unpin all` | Remove pins |
Pins are durable session events (`pin/set`, `pin/remove`). Keep this plugin installed to resume sessions that contain them.

```sh
npm install
npm run build
```

`lib/index.js` is the Host half; `lib/client.js` is the ModuleLoader browser bundle.

Sibling layout expected when typechecking against a local harness is optional — this package uses ambient shims.

在 DeepSeek Harness 会话里钉住助手回复（或工具结果 / 自由文本），再把它们召回进下一轮模型上下文。提供斜杠命令，以及 Web 卡片上的操作按钮。

[English](./README.md)

dsh plugin --profile web add github:YOUR_USER/dsh-pin-recall
```

安装后重启 `dsh --profile web`（或在 harness 仓库里用 `pnpm dsh web`），打开 Web UI 并硬刷新。

需要 Node.js，以及已叠加 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-base` + `@deepseek-ai/dsh-web-app` 的 profile。

在**已完成**的助手消息底部操作条中会出现：

| 控件 | 作用 |
|---|---|
| 空心星标（钉住后实心） | 钉住 / 取消钉住该条回复（状态从会话同步） |
| 左下拐角箭头 | 召回全部钉住内容并唤醒 agent（悬停标题：召回…） |

| 命令 | 效果 |
|---|---|
| `/pin` · `/pin last` | 钉住最近一条工具结果或助手消息 |
| `/pin tool` · `/pin assistant` | 钉住最近一条对应类型消息 |
| `/pin msg <messageId>` | 按消息 id 切换钉住（Web 卡片用） |
| `/pin status <messageId>` | 查询该助手消息是否已钉住 |
| `/pin text …` | 钉住自由文本 |
| `/pins` | 列出当前会话中的钉 |
| `/recall` | 将全部钉排队注入，**并唤醒** agent |
| `/recall p1` | 只召回指定钉并唤醒 |
| `/recall quiet` | 只排队、不唤醒（自行再发一条消息） |
| `/unpin p1` · `/unpin all` | 移除单个或全部钉 |

钉以会话事件持久化（`pin/set`、`pin/remove`）。含钉的会话需要继续安装本插件才能正确恢复。

```sh
npm install
npm run build
```

- `lib/index.js`：Host 侧（命令与会话事件）
- `lib/client.js`：ModuleLoader 浏览器包（操作条按钮）

对本地 harness 做类型检查时的兄弟目录布局是可选的；本包使用 ambient shim。
